title: PLX manual-process baseline (ENG-11)
description: One human-timed manual investigation of an eval item: a person answers the item's question the way the work is done today (Portal, BC, Outlook, SharePoint, FileMaker, paper), with a stopwatch, and records what it took. evals.measure.compare pairs it with the Workbench's runs of the same item_id; an item without a record is reported as unmeasured, never given an assumed time. Times only, never a business value: the record names no identifier, quantity or citation. Validated with ontology/json_contract.py.

item_id.description: The eval item the person investigated (its question, as known at its time).

measured_by.description: Role or initials of the person who did the manual investigation.

method.description: Wall-clock time measured while a person worked; never an estimate.

time_to_first_evidence_seconds.description: Seconds until the person opened the first record or document that supports the answer; null when none was found.

time_to_answer_seconds.description: Seconds until the person stated an answer or stopped (gave up).

unsupported_assertions.description: Statements in the person's answer they could not point to a record or document for.

review_items.description: Open points the person left for someone else to check (an identity, a conflict, a follow-up).
